2608.23114.title: DeMixPert: Decomposed Response Modeling with Gaussian Mixtures for OOD Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
2608.23114.paper_summary: Predicting transcriptome-wide responses to unseen genetic perturbations remains a major computational challenge because accurate prediction requires recovering both perturbation-specific transcriptional shifts and heterogeneous cellular responses. Existing methods often entangle deterministic response structure with stochastic population-level variation, causing dominant shared patterns to mask weaker perturbation-specific signals and impair distributional modeling. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{DeMixPert}, an approach for Decomposed response Modeling with Gaussian Mixtures for Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) single-cell Perturbation prediction. DeMixPert decomposes perturbation-induced changes into a basal-state-dependent systematic response, a perturbation-specific response, and population-level variation. The systematic component is derived from the basal state encoded from control-cell expression, whereas the perturbation-specific component is inferred from pretrained target embeddings for unseen-target generalization. DeMixPert models population-level variation using a Gaussian prototype Invertible Network and adaptively combines reusable Gaussian prototypes according to the basal state and perturbation condition. The resulting mixture is mapped to a condition-specific variation distribution. Sampled variations are integrated with the systematic and perturbation-specific components, followed by joint decoding with the basal state to reconstruct perturbed-cell gene expression. Experimental results show that DeMixPert effectively captures heterogeneous single-cell perturbation responses and achieves superior performance across unseen-perturbation settings. The source code is made publicly available upon publication.
2608.23114.paper_summary_zh: 預測轉錄組範圍內對未見基因擾動的反應仍然是一項主要的計算挑戰，因為準確的預測需要恢復擾動特異的轉錄變化和異質的細胞反應。現有的方法通常將確定性反應結構與隨機的群體級變異糾纏在一起，導致主導的共享模式掩蓋了較弱的擾動特異信號，並損害了分佈建模。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了\textbf{DeMixPert}，這是一種用於分解反應建模的高斯混合方法，旨在進行超出分佈（OOD）單細胞擾動預測。DeMixPert將擾動引起的變化分解為基礎狀態依賴的系統反應、擾動特異反應和群體級變異。系統組件是從控制細胞表達編碼的基礎狀態中推導出來的，而擾動特異組件則是從預訓練的目標嵌入中推斷出來的，以實現對未見目標的泛化。DeMixPert使用高斯原型可逆網絡建模群體級變異，並根據基礎狀態和擾動條件自適應地組合可重用的高斯原型。生成的混合物被映射到特定條件的變異分佈。採樣的變異與系統和擾動特異組件相結合，然後與基礎狀態進行聯合解碼，以重建擾動細胞的基因表達。實驗結果顯示，DeMixPert有效捕捉異質的單細胞擾動反應，並在未見擾動設置中達到優越的性能。源代碼在發表時會公開提供。
